recap.text: Carl and Donut enter the Stage Performance Guild, which opens only to someone who sings with the needle in the green. Carl drinks the singing potion early, reads the Gelded Choirboy scroll, and sounds as if he has sucked helium. He sings Take On Me through a bar brawl, catches Donut's toppling microphone stand between his toes, and hits the high note. A paralysed kappa falls on Donut during her last line, and Carl is granted permanent access.

beats.headline: Squeaky on purpose
beats.text: The guild only opens to someone who sings a song with the needle in the green. Mordecai has compounded a few special potions together, a new trick to get round potion cooldowns, so Carl and Donut stay in sync; Carl takes the lead on a two-singer song. The scroll, Gelded Choirboy, is so he can physically hit notes his deeper voice cannot. Mordecai insists the name is not literal. It will make him squeaky, so he will read it at the last second. The singing potion lasts a long while, so he drinks it now: Honeyed, Yo-Yo Ma'd, Dio'd. Onstage he reads the scroll. You've been Choired! He sounds as if he has sucked helium. Then Dwight stabs the DJ.
beats.gist: Carl reads the Gelded Choirboy scroll onstage to hit high notes and sounds like he has sucked helium.

beats.headline: The high note
beats.text: Carl sings Take On Me through a full bar brawl. Bottles break against him, Dong clears the stage with his sock, and on the extra-high note the gauge by Carl's head chimes and showers digital sparkles. Half the crowd stops fighting. Both gauges sit all the way in the green, his with little flames out of the top. He catches Donut's toppling microphone stand between his toes and keeps singing, off the stage as the curtains burn. Fireworks on the long last note. A paralysed kappa falls on Donut during her final line. Carl is granted permanent access to the Stage Performance Guild.
beats.gist: Carl sings Take On Me through a bar brawl and is granted permanent Stage Performance Guild access.

relations.note: he compounded the singing potions read alongside it
